PLAIN AND SIMPLE

Your privacy.

This showcase does not require an account or collect payment information.

Saved on your device.

When you save a build, its case and keycap selections are stored in your browser’s local storage. You can remove individual builds from Saved builds, or clear site data in your browser. These selections are not sent to a formkey database.

Hosting and external resources.

The site hosting provider processes requests to serve these pages and may retain operational logs under its own terms. Google Fonts is requested for typography and receives normal connection information, including your IP address. System fonts are used if external fonts are unavailable.

No analytics installed.

This version has no analytics scripts, advertising pixels, tracking cookies, or contact form. This notice must be reviewed if those services, checkout, or customer accounts are introduced.
